text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 45 units of idarubicin hydrochloride 1 mg/mL 20 mL single-dose vials with a daily use of 3.6 units, providing 12.6 days on hand as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list idarubicin hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 13 days. No national shortage is posted. A purchase option exists but the manufacturer's label does not identify a production site we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to contact Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. to confirm lot availability, lead time, and manufacturing site; buyer approves the purchase order if terms are acceptable.
2. Buyer to provide the committee with a written summary of the vendor response and cost comparison within five business days; committee chair approves proceeding.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA's shortage list daily and report any new posting to the committee at the next scheduled meeting; committee chair acknowledges the report.

Not recommended: Initiate therapeutic alternatives or protocol changes based on supply projections alone.
